{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the structure and data types
df_info = trial_df.info()

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()

# Check unique values in 'arm' column
treatment_arm_unique = trial_df['arm'].unique()

# Check unique values in 'responded' column
responded_unique = trial_df['responded'].unique()

# Return all the findings
df_info, missing_values, treatment_arm_unique, responded_unique"}
